reason: The primary CIF is valid and round-trips in independent parsers: Im-3 (No. 204), cubic a = 7.53260 A, 26 fully occupied atoms (Al24Tc2, Z = 2), with Tc on 2a and Al on 24g; primitive standardization gives 13 atoms and Al12Tc. All important observed lines from 5-90 degrees are covered by the I-cubic lattice with no significant unindexed reflection. Although no separate comparable Rwp was supplied, the trace contains auditable instantiated-model intensity evidence: independent integrated-intensity fits from multiple starts converge to Al coordinates (0, 0.18765, 0.30770), essentially the submitted (0, 0.1878, 0.3077), and the submitted model reproduces the extracted line intensities with correlation 0.9996. Periodic chemistry is valid, with no overlap (shortest Tc-Al 2.715 A and Al-Al 2.762 A) and a complete 12-Al first shell around Tc. The concrete alternative ordering with Tc moved onto a centering-related pair of framework sites is quantitatively excluded: it predicts a strong otherwise extinct N=8/220 line (~19.7 relative intensity versus ~0.085 observed) and worsens the weighted integrated-intensity residual from ~0.9 to ~20. No material ordering, symmetry, occupancy, or framework branch survives the diffraction and validity checks.
